We’re so back… to fixing the damn roads 💪

Video

Caught up with our favorite new Michigander, Jase!

Video

It was great to welcome home @QuinnXCII for his From Michigan With Love tour! 

You always have ✋ to call home 🫶

You know the ads, you know the billboards, you know the catchphrase -- you know Pure Michigan.
 
It's in our lakes and our air, our laughs and our people, we attract travelers from all across the world because no one does pure like Michigan.

Fix the damn roads season is here! With a whole new construction season, we’ve got another chance to put the pedal to the metal on fixing local roads.

We’ve got the funds, we’ve got the crews, we’ve got the drive, let’s get it done.

Nothing like tackling the problems of tomorrow over pancakes! 

It’s great to be back for Pancakes & Politics, an event that reminds us we are stronger when we work towards what brings us together: a growing economy, good-paying jobs, and a brighter future.

Michigan is THE place for bold, bright ideas. We’re a state that drives innovation and gets shit done. That is the fuel behind every business who shared their vision at Pitch MI. 

Michigan will keep showing up for small business the way they show up for our us.

Everyone deserves a shot at a place to call home.

The time is now to cut red tape and streamline zoning so we can make it easier to build more affordable homes for all Michiganders.

Let me be clear: our elections are safe and secure. Any attempt to federalize our elections or make it harder for Americans to cast their ballots is an attempt to take away Michiganders’ constitutional right to vote.

We all want big futures for our kids, but here’s the truth: we won’t get there unless we tackle this head‑on.

Today is Autism Awareness Day, when we celebrate the strengths and perspectives of Michiganders on the autism spectrum. Today, this month, and always, we commit to listen, learn, and build spaces where everyone can thrive. Together, we can make a more inclusive Michigan for all.
Gas is too damn expensive.   While I can't end a war overseas or undo tariff policies, I will do what I can as governor to give families a break. clickondetroit.com/news/loca…

This executive directive will show us damage from tariffs and help get refunds to Michigan businesses. I continue to call on Congress to set a strategic trade policy that lowers costs and creates good-paying jobs.
 
I will keep working every day to lower costs here in Michigan.

Today I signed an executive directive to help Michigan businesses receive refunds for tariff costs. The president’s tariffs have jacked up costs and Michiganders have paid the price. The Supreme Court ruled that these tariffs are illegal. Michiganders deserve their money back.
